punchy_moves.tutorial.body.0: A short tour of your third-person camera, your emotes and your settings. Use Next or the arrow keys to go on. You can skip it now and replay it any time with Replay tutorial in the Camera tab.
punchy_moves.tutorial.body.1: The camera key switches the custom camera on and off. The orbit key lets the camera circle your character without turning the body, while WASD still moves you; press it again to take the camera back.
punchy_moves.tutorial.body.2: Open the wheel and click an emote to play it; the X in the middle closes it. Each card shows its own shortcut. The emotes on offer come from your animation pack.
punchy_moves.tutorial.body.3: Camera, Features and Shortcuts are in the column on the left. Opening the panel does not switch the camera on.
punchy_moves.tutorial.body.4: Switch the custom camera on in Camera. Features decides how the camera moves at fences, on ladders, with an elytra and near blocks, how it aims a bow or crossbow, and whether your body faces a ladder.
punchy_moves.tutorial.body.5: In Camera, Horizontal moves the camera sideways, Vertical sets its height, Depth its distance and Field of View how wide you see. Scroll for the rotation sliders. While you drag one, only it stays on screen so you can judge the view; let go to see the panel again.
punchy_moves.tutorial.body.6: Your keys are listed here. Open Minecraft key binds to change them, under Punchy Moves. To see this guide again, use Replay tutorial in the Camera tab.
